context.passage:
Transport Quarterly
EDITOR'S NOTE:
• 0°
The news often talks about the use of driverless passenger cars in the near future,
but self-directed trucks (SDTs) will likely be transporting deliveries on the country's
roadways even sooner, perhaps within the next several years. In our autumn issue,
we check in with industry experts for analysis on issues related to SDTs. Kimiko
Murayama of Myeong Solutions talks about the economic tactors that are making
SDTs a reality. Telotin Technology's Jane Tilly takes a look at the technology that is
literally "driving" SDTs. Leo Radosh of The Tapton Engineering Group describes
advances in global positioning system (GPS) technology and the role that it will
play in the acceptance of SDTs.
*E-mail*
To:
kmurayama@msolutions.co.uk
From:
Igagnon@bunburyit.ac.uk
Subject:
Visiting BIT
Date:
14 January
Dear Ms. Murayama,
I teach an undergraduate course called Transportation and Distribution at the Bunbury
Institute of Technology (BIT), which includes a unit on cost structures for freight
carriers. I would like to invite you to visit my class as a guest speaker. I saw your
article in Transport Quarterly, and I was going to assign it as required reading for my
students. It then occurred to me that your company is only a 10-minute drive from our
campus. My students would be very interested in your thoughts on self-driving fleets.
The class meets Tuesday and Thursday mornings from 9:00 to 11:15, and there are
74 students enrolled. I can fit your visit into the schedule at any point between now and
our exams on 12 March. Although I do not have a budget to compensate you for your
time and travel, I would be delighted to treat you to lunch after class. I do hope you
will see your way to visiting us here at BIT in the near future.
Yours truly,
Dr. Loudon Gagnon
Department of Transportation Engineering
Bunbury Institute of Technology
Bunbury Institute of Technology

context.passage_translation:
运输季刊
编辑按语：
• 0°
新闻经常谈论未来使用自动驾驶客车，但自主牵引卡车（SDTs）可能更早地在国家的道路上进行货物运输，也许在接下来的几年内。在我们秋季刊中，我们邀请行业专家就与 SDT 相关的问题进行分析。Myeong Solutions 的 Kimiko Murayama 谈到了使 SDT 成为现实的经济因素。Telotin Technology 的 Jane Tilly 考察了“驱动”SDT 的技术。The Tapton Engineering Group 的 Leo Radosh 描述了全球定位系统（GPS）技术的进步及其在接受 SDT 中所起的作用。
*电子邮件*
收件人：kmurayama@msolutions.co.uk
发件人：Igagnon@bunburyit.ac.uk
主题：访问 BIT
日期：1月14日
尊敬的 Murayama 女士：
我在 Bunbury 技术学院（BIT）教授一门名为“运输与分配”的本科课程，其中包括一个关于货运公司成本结构的单元。我想邀请您作为客座演讲嘉宾来我的课堂做一次访问。我看了您在《运输季刊》上的文章，原计划让它成为我学生必读材料。然后我想到贵公司距离我们的校园只有 10 分钟车程。我的学生会对您关于自动驾驶车队的看法非常感兴趣。
课程于周二和周四上午 9:00 到 11:15 上课，目前有 74 名学生注册。在现在到我们 3 月 12 日考试期间的任何时间都可以安排您的访问。虽然我没有预算为您的时间和差旅报销，但我非常乐意在课后请您吃午饭。我希望您能在不久的将来能来 BIT 拜访我们。
此致，
Loudon Gagnon 博士
交通工程系
Bunbury 技术学院
Bunbury 技术学院
员工费用报告
姓名：
Loudon Gagnon 博士
部门：
交通工程
日期：
2月12日
金额：
£40
购买描述：
在举办课程 316（运输与分配）客座讲师的学院俱乐部午餐
如需报销，请附上原始收据。
所有超过 £200 的费用必须事先获得学院院长批准。
经 Frank Nadal 于 2 月 19 日批准付款。
